units.name: DecodePassword
units.summary: bank 0 $8990: Inverse of EncodePassword.  Converts the 7 letter numbers (A = 1) to 5-bit values through PasswordCharValue, checks the checksum (low nibble of the sum of values 0-5 must equal value 6), takes the stage from value 5 / 2 and rebuilds the four letters of Player1Name (value + 16 when the overflow bit in value 4 is set, minus stage and position, plus 'A'; '@' becomes a blank).  A valid password leaves TourStage = stage + 1 (must be 1-4).  Anything else shows "THE PASSWORD IS WRONG." for two seconds and leaves TourStage = 0.

regions.summary: Data (VoiceTable1). Samples 0-6 of banks 2/3: 7 records of (address word, length byte, spare byte). The player writes (word << 2) >> 8 to DMC_START, so a sample starts at $C000 + 64 * that value (the bank 2 words are not 64-byte aligned and are rounded down), and length byte L gives 16 * L + 1 bytes.  The samples follow each other from $C040 to $FA51.

phase1.evidence: DPCM voice data (lead L-010). Consumer VoicePlayer1/2 ($FA7C/$FCC0, banks 3/5, observed code) indexes a 4-byte table at $C009 (A*4) and writes ((word<<2)>>8) to $4012 and len to $4013; PlayVoiceSample (bank 0 $9CE9) maps bank pair 2/3 or 4/5 at $C000 (context [0,1,2,3]/[0,1,4,5]). Exactly 7 entries per table: DMC start $C000+64*k and length 16*L+1 tile the samples contiguously from $C040 to $FA41 (bank 2/3) and $C040 to $FCC0 = VoicePlayer2 (bank 4/5). Static structural inference reviewed in round 2. Object: VoiceTable1 bank2 $C009-$C024: 7 x (addr word,len,spare); tiles $C040..$FA51.

units.name: VoicePlayer1
units.summary: bank 3 $FA7C: A = sample number in this bank.  Sets the DMC start address (word << 2, high byte) and length from the table at $C009, starts the DMC at rate $0D and busy-waits until the sample ends.

phase1.evidence: Uniform $00 run of 1351 bytes extending to the bank trailer/end; no observed or static code reaches it; BRK-only content is not executable code. First byte could terminate preceding data (non-code either way).

units.name: DecompressScreen
units.summary: bank 14 $CEB3: Decompresses the stream at (ScreenDataPtr)+4 (length = byte 2 + 4) into ScreenBuf.
